adjudication.rationale: In `admin-group.js.es6` the `next`/`previous` actions immediately mutate `model.offset` and then call `group.findMembers()` with no in-flight guard or request sequencing. `findMembers` issues an async `Discourse.ajax(...).then(...)` and unconditionally `setProperties({ offset: result.meta.offset, members: ... })` on resolution. With rapid clicks or slow/out-of-order responses, an earlier request can resolve after a later one and overwrite `offset/members` with stale page data, effectively showing a different page than the user’s last action. Additionally, there’s no error handling; on failure the optimistic `offset` change remains while `members` stays from the prior page, creating a page-number/list mismatch.
